connector.name: Hyre MCP
connector.registryDescription: 17 DeFi + RWA tools - PumpFun, wallet PnL, Meteora LP, Robinhood Chain stocks - paid via x402.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package hyre-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cryptoeights account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: SVM_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Base58-encoded Solana private key for a funded wallet (needs USDC for payments + a little SOL for gas). Used to auto-pay x402 micropayments. If omitted, tools return the 402 payment requirements instead of live data.

env.name: HYRE_API_URL
env.description: Override the HYRE MPP API base URL. Defaults to the production endpoint.
